0.why: src/PadX.cpp:130 getChannels() bounds the per-cell range test, :132 getVoltage(c) for the matched channel
src/PadX.cpp:131 setChannels(1) on every one of the sixteen outputs

comment: No family is given to these ports: the module passes on whatever lane is patched into it, and the maker's own manual says the module does not care which lane that is. All sixteen outputs are written by the same three lines (src/PadX.cpp:128-132), so one props entry covers them. A channel-count mismatch is checked here rather than trusted from Pads, so an out-of-range cell reads 0V rather than a stale voltage.
